# elevate-neoterra-client

> All NeoTerra communications get priority treatment — this is the anchor consulting client funding David's transition to full-time founder.

## Trigger and action

**When:** Fires when an email arrives from any @neoterragroup.com address or mentions NeoTerra in the subject.
**Then:** Route to priority triage with client-context flag; never delay or batch.

## Rationale

The 'Consulting Funds the Dream' pattern is unambiguous: NeoTerra is David's financial engine during the most precarious phase of his founder journey. The $6,237.43 Stripe payout, regular Wise transfers via Ugly Code LLC, and 38 NeoTerra emails confirm deep integration. David has a dedicated @neoterragroup.com address and structured weekly calls with Rob (CEO), Caddie (Development Manager), and Henry.

David left Stylers Group roughly six weeks ago and is funding everything — the new Kft, a second property purchase, construction projects, 100+ SaaS subscriptions — primarily through NeoTerra revenue. A missed email from Caddie about a deliverable, from Rob about a scope change, or from Henry about a call reschedule directly threatens the income stream that makes everything else viable.

This instinct is separate from the general inner-circle rule because NeoTerra comms have different operational semantics: they may require same-day response, they often involve shared documents or meeting coordination across the Brisbane timezone (+8h from CEST), and they carry revenue-risk consequences that personal emails don't.
